title: Equality and Object Identity knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Equality and Object Identity”?
options: It makes versioning, input validation, and testing unnecessary.
It means all Kotlin libraries and platform APIs behave identically.

questions.answer_key: Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
